ticket.title: verifying a ticket does not check that its commits are reachable from any merged branch, so work can be certified and stranded
ticket.description: OBSERVED 2026-11-07: two verified tickets had commits on branches `main` never received. SP-25 was found only because a flag its ticket certified was missing from the installed binary; GB-302 was found by auditing every repository for unmerged branches, which was a question asked by the user rather than a check the tooling performs. Both were merged. FIXED in de95b8c: `show` warns and `show --json` carries `unmerged_receipt` when a receipt's head commit is not reachable from main in the repository the receipt names.

verification_receipt.command: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo nextest run --workspace && miter audit --path . --threshold 250 --paths && chalkline docs check -d .
